hypothesis: Sentence-contrastive multilingual E5 features improve relatedness and zero-shot transfer over MLM-only AfroXLMR features under matched human-source data and head objectives.
cohort: All rows from nine human-source-compatible languages of the fourteen-language shared task. Five mixed-generated-source languages excluded; 51 train duplicates/protected pairs and23 development test copies removed; all test rows unchanged.
pooling: Attention-mask mean including valid special tokens; L2; no pooler; complete backbone loading required.

afro_reuse.basis: All18101 prior encoded sentences have zero128-token truncation. Identical pinned model/tokenizer/prefix means512-token limit changes no old token input. Retain exact old prefix rows and verify every source/cache hash. Actually encode all new Punjabi sentences and require fresh512-token feature replay on all nine languages before fitting.

features: 1539 symmetric absolute-difference/product/cosine/word-Jaccard/Unicode-trigram-Jaccard values; scale with training only.
baseline_scope: Pairwise lexical sets use no fitted vocabulary and cannot silently drop unseen Gurmukhi as out-of-vocabulary.
loss: Equal-five-training-language weighted MSE plus optional0.1 within-language human-order logistic ranking for score gaps>=0.1.
selection: Every seed stops on equal-nine-language development macro Spearman, earliest exact ties. Equal-seed prediction average. First choose strongest fixed baseline across both encoders; learned candidate requires +0.005 macro Spearman and no language regression greater than0.02 against that strongest baseline. Exact ties retain earlier encoder/config; baseline retained if no eligible improvement.
candidate_order: Afro then E5; ridge1/10/100 then MLP control/slower/regularized/ranking0.1.
actual_proofs: Real nine-language encoder repeat/unit-norm smoke; two real training updates and saved-head reload; after global serialization run production text inference and reversal/cache equivalence on one development pair per language.
test: No numeric test targets mounted for encoding/training. Root reviews validation and freezes global checkpoint before separate guarded test release. Three language tests previously observed; report that limitation explicitly. No test-guided selection or switching.
compute: One private free Kaggle CPU job,2threads, sequential encoders/heads. No local encoder allocation or GPU-quota bypass.
limits: Repeated development stopping/selection is not nested validation.
News/source sentence reuse and unknown pretrained exposure remain.
External E5 pretraining includes multilingual retrieval/parallel mixtures; this project adds no generated fine-tuning rows.
